fields.name: PgShardConnectionOptions.PgShardConnectionConfiguration
fields.description: The declared per-shard configuration shape for PgShardConnectionOptions.PgShardConnectionConfiguration: a shard identifier plus independently held read and write PostgreSQL connection configurations, with interface-facing endpoint views.

members.name: ShardId
members.description: Identifier carried by this shard configuration.

members.name: ReadConnectionInternal
members.description: Interface-facing view of the current read connection.

members.name: WriteConnectionInternal
members.description: Interface-facing view of the current write connection.

members.name: ReadConnection
members.description: Typed read endpoint; new instances initialize it with a PgConnectionConfiguration.

members.name: WriteConnection
members.description: Typed write endpoint; new instances initialize it with a PgConnectionConfiguration.

representations.C#: Nested public class whose interface-facing endpoint views derive from the typed read and write endpoint properties.
